subject.title: feat(canvas): export widgets as PNG — copy or download from the card menu

question: Should OpenClaw adopt PNG copy/download as a permanent built-in web-chat widget-card capability, rather than leaving widget export to browser screenshots or a future platform-neutral export contract?
rationale: The patch introduces a new user-facing Canvas and web-chat capability, and the protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human ownership even if implementation details are otherwise sound.

options.title: Sponsor the web export UX
options.body: Accept the web-card PNG export direction once the contributor supplies current-head proof of both Copy and Download outcomes.

options.title: Narrow to download only
options.body: Avoid browser clipboard variability by retaining only a tested PNG download action for the initial web implementation.

options.title: Defer the capability
options.body: Pause this feature until maintainers define a cross-platform widget export contract shared by web and native clients.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the web export UX
recommendation.body: Accept the web-card PNG export direction once the contributor supplies current-head proof of both Copy and Download outcomes.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed web implementation and the adjacent platform export work, so they are the best available person to clarify the intended product boundary.
